d: People. Passion. Pride. This is what has driven our teams since 1833.

Since that time, we have developed to become a critical partner in the global aviation industry, delivering time-critical logistics services at 350 locations in more than 65 countries, across six continents.
But at the heart of our business is our people.

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Boomi Integration Engineer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of integration solutions across our enterprise systems. This role is instrumental in driving end-to-end system integration, process automation, and data flow optimization using the Boomi platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in integration architecture and middleware best practices, with the ability to work cross-functionally and deliver scalable and secure integrations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
8+ years of experience in system integration, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Boomi
Strong experience in integration with enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, HRIS, etc.)
Solid understanding of APIs (REST/SOAP), authentication mechanisms (OAuth, SAML), and secure data exchange
r: Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of complex integrations using Boomi.
Collaborate with business analysts, application owners, and other stakeholders to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Develop and maintain integrations between cloud-based and on-premise systems, including ERPs (e.g., SAP, Oracle), HR systems (e.g., SuccessFactors), CRMs, MS AD, APIs, and third-party platforms.
Define and enforce standards, patterns, and best practices for integration development and maintenance.
Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and security of deployed integrations using Boomi monitoring tools and dashboards.
Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues efficiently, ensuring minimal business disruption.

d: The position is responsible to provide support to the internal brand team for all their inbound and outbound shipments and also to ensure that the shipments are customs cleared and delivered on time to the warehouse and the stores using the most cost-effective means.
Establishing contact with the Supplier/ Agent for cargo pick up post aligning with the Brand team.
Coordinate with freight forwarder to arrange collection for Import & re-export and follow up till goods delivery at the warehouse / Stores.
Invite freight quotes from various service providers and prepare comparisons for ADHOC shipments.
Facilitate the movement of stocks (Inbound & Outbound) using the most cost-efficient means of transport, at the earliest possible lead time.
Generate shipping documents for outbound shipments to GCC and local exports to UAE.
Validate all customs BOE & freight invoices and handover to finance for payment process in a timely manner so that shipments are not impacted.
Process BOE & making customs duty payments for all inbound and outbound shipments.
Brand Manager/Merchandiser/Logistics Executive, Dubai Customs, Dubai Trade, Manager – Central Logistics etc.
